additional_info.subject: ID0483037-DC/Si-D/BE- [Y2 / S6 313717534005] Charger Offline Investigation CRM:03209000292
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0483037
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Siemens
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / S6 313717534005
Charger ID / Serial No.:
UBPBfx
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: SCB offline
Following your report, and after checking the charger we see that the SCB connection to our system is offline. We conclude that your report is regarding the SCB connection, and we will guide you to be able to resolve this issue.
As you mentioned, the sim card of the charger has already been checked.
Other possible causes for the SCB to be offline, are the following. Please check these steps:
1. The internet cable of the charger.
2. The router of the charger - please make sure to check the following steps below:
Router RUT241
Has FW version higher than v7.06.3
Workaround:
1. Upload v7.06.3 to Router in /tmp folder via WinSCP
2. sysupgrade -F -c RUT2M_R_00.07.06.3_WEBUI.bin
3. change LAN IP address manually to 10.20.17.1/2
4. via SSH do: echo -e "admin01\nadmin01\n" | passwd && echo -e "admin01\nadmin01\n" | passwd admin
5. Reboot
When these steps are checked, and the issue is still not resolved, please go ahead for replacement of the router.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
